LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_FactionOutpost.label: Faction outposts
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_FactionOutpost.descri: Periodically generate outposts established by other human factions near the player's colony. Hostile, friendly, and neutral weights determine which current relationship category is selected only when a new outpost is generated. After generation, the outpost always follows its faction's actual diplomatic relationship with the player.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_OrdinaryFactionRelati: Configure this game's initial relationship mode with regular factions.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_MechHiveRelation.desc: Configure this game's relationship mode with the mechanoid hive.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_InsectRelation.label: Insect hive relations
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_InsectRelation.descri: Configure this game's relationship mode with the insect hive faction.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_MechHiveNode.label: Generate mechanoid hive nodes
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_MechHiveNode.descript: When enabled, periodically attempt to generate a mechanoid hive node under construction.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_PurgeDirective.label: Route: Purge directive
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_PurgeDirective.descri: Experience the purge protocol route: play as a killing machine deployed by the cerebrex, ruthlessly clearing all intelligent organic beings. Earn the cerebrex's trust through tasks to gain the mechanoid hive's support.
LanguageData.MAP_StoryComponent_SymbiosisCovenant.des: Experience the Symbiosis covenant route: play as a mechanoid freed from the cerebrex's control, earn other factions' trust, improve diplomatic relations, and form a multilateral alliance against the cerebrex.
